Subject: Request for Flexible Hours – Medical Accommodation  

Dear Tom Reyes,  

I’m writing to let you know that I was recently diagnosed with type 1 diabetes at Hanbit Clinic. As I adjust to the new treatment plan over the next two months, I would appreciate a flexible schedule (e.g., adjusted start/end times or occasional remote work) to attend medical appointments and manage my health.  

I remain fully committed to my responsibilities and will ensure all deliverables stay on track. Please let me know if we should discuss any specific arrangements.  

Thank you for your understanding.  

Best regards,  
Jane Park
